ui_bugs.issue: The actual served preview HTML does not include the required apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta tag. Runtime head metas were only viewport/theme-color/description, despite frontend/public/index.html containing the new tags.
The QR manual tag input touch target is below the requested 44px minimum on 390x844 viewport: bounding box height was 42px. Lookup and Start camera buttons were 44px.

issues: Manual lookup works and returns the asset result, but native/PWA metadata is missing from the live served page.
Manual input inline height remains 42px, so not all mobile touch targets meet the 44px requirement.

action_items: Make the live served frontend HTML include apple-mobile-web-app-capable/mobile PWA meta tags; public/index.html has them in source but the preview response for /scan does not.
Increase the QR manual input touch target to at least 44px high on mobile, e.g. min-height:44px for [data-testid=qr-manual-input] or a QR-specific mobile CSS rule.
Re-test /scan on a 390x844 viewport after the frontend rebuild/restart and CSS change.
